mapper.select: SELECT * from book_subject_period where subject_id = #{subjectId} and year_period = #{period} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_subject_period (subject_id,period_init_balance,period_end_balance,year_period,create_time,update_time) SELECT subject_id, IFNULL((SELECT bsp.period_end_balance from book_subject_period bsp where bsp.year_period = #{previousPeriod} and bsp.subject_id = bs.subject_id),bs.balance_init), balance,#{period},NOW(),NOW() FROM book_subject bs WHERE bs.book_id = #{bookId}
mapper.update: UPDATE book_subject_period SET period_end_balance = period_end_balance + #{diffMoney} where subject_id = #{subjectId} and year_period = #{yearPeriod}

UPDATE book_subject_period SET period_init_balance = period_init_balance + #{diffMoney}, period_end_balance = period_end_balance + #{diffMoney} where subject_id = #{subjectId} and year_period > #{yearPeriod}
